description: Capability bundles (recipes) compose AgentHub packages and tracked third-party extensions for a job. Bundles are install-planning metadata; they are not mega-plugins and do not vendor upstream code.

bundles.title: Technical series production
bundles.summary: Produce a fictionalized technical story series with evidence-bound capture, explanation, and optional Remotion composition.
notes: story-series-studio and technical-storytelling are registered AgentHub packages.
media-studio is the public video pack; live-product screencasts invoke the internal engine in packages/product-demo-studio.
startup-series remains a Receipts-specific overlay that requires the generic studio packages.

bundles.title: Engaging learning
bundles.summary: Attention-friendly exam coaching with optional visual explainers.
notes: learning-studio and technical-storytelling are registered AgentHub packages.
Remotion/animations are optional enhancements, not required to answer a question.

bundles.title: Local media production
bundles.summary: Writer/storyboard/director crew for briefings, training, explainers, talking-heads, animation, and audio on Local-AI, with Remotion archetype composition for viewer-facing films and Recast pointer finishing for screencasts.
notes: media-studio is the public pack and covers product screencasts plus briefings, training, explainers, talking-heads, animation, and audio. The gated Playwright/Recast engine remains packages/product-demo-studio.

Remotion is required at runtime for viewer-facing briefing, training, explainer, and series-episode jobs unless intent is draft or the user asked for a basic/proxy cut. Do not vendor Remotion rules; install official remotion-dev/skills.
creative-writing-skills is recommended for viewer-facing narrative (explainers, branded films, series), not for Descript finishing.
Owner voice is Local-AI qwen-clone --voice sarosh only.
